name: foco-java
description: Fork desktop Electron do Foco, com backend Spring e SQLite local

scripts.build:desktop: tsc -b desktop/tsconfig.app.json && vite build --config desktop/vite.config.ts && node desktop/scripts/copy-electron-files.cjs && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.new.yml
scripts.build:stable: npm run build:backend && tsc -b desktop/tsconfig.app.json && vite build --config desktop/vite.config.ts && node desktop/scripts/copy-electron-files.cjs && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.stable.yml
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:desktop
